changes_made.explanation: Consolidated dataset names to canonical forms and removed redundant descriptions. Added Yelp Review which was mentioned in the paper for classifier training. Kept all models as they are explicitly used in the experiments.
Consolidated metric variants to base forms following simplification rules. All variations (Dist-1/2/3, PPL variants) are captured by the base metric names.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was used in this paper. The paper uses classifier-based metrics and human evaluation, but no post-generation LLM assessment.
